Title: n8n: Snowflake Node executeQuery Operation Allows SQL Injection via Unparameterized Expression Interpolation
Description:
The n8n Snowflake node's Execute Query operation interpolated expression values directly into the SQL string, making queries built with untrusted data susceptible to SQL injection.

Exploitation requires that a workflow author has already embedded untrusted expression data directly in a raw SQL query.
AffectedVersions: All versions before 1.123.67, all versions starting from 2.0.0-rc.0 before 2.31.5, all versions starting from 2.32.0 before 2.32.1
NotImpacted: All versions starting from 1.123.67 before 2.0.0-rc.0, all versions starting from 2.31.5 before 2.32.0, all versions starting from 2.32.1
